values.summary: After WP-04 lands, inventory existing ACIP/A2A/WSS/trace contracts, freeze one semantic envelope and compatibility policy, implement protobuf/catalog/deterministic JSON parity, harden authenticated bounded WSS admission and reconnect behavior, then run round-trip, denial, replay, malformed, real-carrier, platform, and exact-head proof.

steps.action: Verify WP-04 and trace/stream baselines, inventory semantic drift, and freeze envelope, version, compatibility, schema, catalog, JSON, and carrier contracts.
Implement protobuf/catalog/JSON parity plus authenticated bounded WSS negotiation, admission, dispatch, errors, reconnect, and backpressure.
Run golden round trips, compatibility and denial negatives, real bidirectional WSS exchange, and native-platform proof.
Resolve exact-head review and publish stable consumer handoff with closing linkage.

invariants: One semantic message has equivalent protobuf and deterministic JSON meaning
Unsupported versions and unknown required fields fail without guessing
Malformed, oversized, replayed, wrong-runtime, or denied frames fail before dispatch
Authentication and signed command policy remain Runtime-owned
Queues and binary payloads remain bounded
Public catalog cannot silently diverge from the wire schema
risks: Existing ACIP/A2A envelopes may encode conflicting semantics
JSON number/byte/omission rules could drift from protobuf
Version negotiation could accidentally accept incompatible majors
WSS auth, reconnect, or backpressure could widen authority or duplicate dispatch
stop_conditions: Issue 5821 architecture/security gate is not terminal
Issue 5862 WP-04-IMP or any of issues 5863 through 5878 lacks terminal integrated evidence
Semantic envelope, schema, catalog, JSON, or WSS authority remains ambiguous
Any declared path overlaps an active owner
Native macOS, Linux, or Windows proof cannot be produced
replan_triggers: WP-04 changes distributed identity or transport assumptions
Compatibility fixtures expose semantic loss between protobuf and JSON
Consumer integration requires a previously undeclared versioning rule
